fusions.name: Capped Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves with a hard cap for 12 damage, knocking the target back 3 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Venting Gills
fusions.desc: Vents spores in a ring, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and costing 4% of your maximum health. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bracket Barrier
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 25 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Parasol Veil
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, a ward absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
